name: Fragment Echo
description: A pale, grey after-image of a body, the Fragmented State as some layers render it.
role: The look of a Fragment Echo, a remnant that fragmented and never reintegrated.

artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
artBrief.silhouette: Soft figure outline with a faded lower half.
artBrief.detail: Pale greys with dark eyes and no clothing detail.
